topic: how to get retrieve collect WAEC certificate school private digital
value_text: To get your WAEC certificate in Nigeria, the route depends on your examination type. School candidates should contact the school where they sat WASSCE to collect the physical certificate. Private candidates can request collection through WAEC at https://certrequest.waec.ng/ and choose a WAEC office for pickup; WAEC says processing may take 10–30 days and identification is required. For an official digital copy, register for Candidate Certificate Access at https://portal.waec.org/account/register, then follow the platform instructions to access and share your certificate. If you have lost your certificate or examination number, check WAEC DigiCert's recovery options. Use only WAEC's official portals and confirm applicable charges there.

topic: what is WAEC DigiCert digital certificate service meaning
value_text: WAEC DigiCert is WAEC's official digital certificate service. It lets eligible candidates access, download and securely share digital versions of their WAEC certificates, and offers examination-number recovery. Visit https://www.waec.org/ or create a Candidate Certificate Access account at https://portal.waec.org/account/register. It is different from collecting a physical certificate from your school or WAEC office.

topic: how to check view NECO SSCE examination result online result checker token
value_text: To check your NECO result, visit https://results.neco.gov.ng/. Select your examination year and examination type, enter a valid result-checking token and your NECO registration number, then click Check my result. If you do not have a token, use the official NECO portal to obtain one. Result checking is different from NECO e-Verify for institutional verification.
